_comment: Plugin Architecture Canon §7.4 layer 3 — the third independent
enforcement layer for Tōro. Tools enumerated below are the ONLY
MCP servers Tōro and its sub-agents may connect to. Anything
absent from this list cannot be called regardless of what an
agent.yaml claims, because the protocol is never registered.
Belt-and-braces with: (1) agent.yaml allowed_tools positive list,
(2) agent.yaml denied_tools explicit prohibitions, (3) THIS file.
PERMANENTLY EXCLUDED per canon §8.1 (the 'never build' set): SMS
send, email send, push send, calendar create-external-event,
Privacy Commissioner notifiable breach, IRD myIR file, WorkSafe
notifiable event, Companies Office register, NZ Customs TSW
lodge, MPI biosecurity declare. PRs adding any of these are

chatwoot-readonly._purpose: List conversations and messages within the pilot inbox. READ ONLY — Tōro never posts via Chatwoot directly. Outbound sends are gated through /app/toro/inbox approval click → server-side action.

supabase-toro-drafts._purpose: Read and write toro_drafts only. RLS scoped to authenticated tenant_members. NO write access to toroa_*, audit_log, or any other table.
